newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bosch to invest 34 mln dmk in French plant.
newsitem.headline: Bosch to invest 34 mln dmk in French plant.

text.p: German automotive parts company Robert Bosch GmbH said on Tuesday it would invest about 34 million marks in its French Moulins plant between 1997 and 1999.
The decision was made by the management of Bosch's French subsidiary, the company said in Stuttgart. Around 380 workers will produce components for braking systems in the factory.
The construction of two production lines for the Bosch anti-lock braking system will begin at the end of 1998.
At that time the construction of the brakes system by the U.S. company Allied Signal will run out.
Early in the year Bosch took over the brakes business of the Allied Signal.
Bosch manufactures anti-locking systems in four German and seven foreign locations. The group currently employs 9,500 workers in France.
